title: Name a value
summary: Haskell: Name a value. Use 6 pencils. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A name can stand for a value. Haskell names do not work like boxes that are updated later.

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
pencils names the value 3. The expression passed to print evaluates to 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Give the name one definition in this scope.
